basic_info.description: Bask in incredible south-facing views and all-day sun at 4141 23rd Street, a masterfully reimagined 1904 Victorian on a quiet street with ample parking  just a five-minute stroll to 24th Street or the Castro. This 6-bedroom, 4.5-bath home spans four luminous levels, blending timeless character with modern sophistication. The top floor hosts a luxury primary suite with sweeping southern views, a spa-like bath, and two additional bedrooms with a shared bath. The main level centers on a light-filled great room with a chef's kitchen featuring Wolf appliances, Carrara marble, a breakfast area, and expansive windows framing panoramic vistas, flowing seamlessly to a view deck ideal for indoor/outdoor living. On the garden level, a private au-pair suite offers a bedroom, living and dining areas, a full bath, laundry hookups, and French doors opening to an expansive patio. Loaded with integrated technology  audio/video, Sonos sound, WiFi access points on every level, and EV charging  the home is completed by landscaped gardens, multiple decks, and a mature fruiting fig tree. A rare Noe Valley retreat where light, views, and walkability converge.
